queries:
SELECT observstation,
       COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM telescopes) AS share,
       1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT observstation) FROM telescopes) AS avg_share,
       COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM telescopes) - 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT observstation) FROM telescopes) AS difference
FROM telescopes
GROUP BY observstation
ORDER BY difference DESC
LIMIT 10;
WITH c AS (
  SELECT t.observstation, COUNT(*) AS n
  FROM signals s
  JOIN telescopes t ON s.telescref = t.telescregistry
  GROUP BY t.observstation
), tot AS (
  SELECT SUM(n) AS total FROM c
)
SELECT AVG(1.0 * c.n / tot.total) AS avg_share
FROM c, tot;
SELECT o.observstation, COUNT(t.telescregistry) AS telescope_count
FROM observatories o
LEFT JOIN telescopes t ON t.observstation = o.observstation
GROUP BY o.observstation
HAVING CAST(COUNT(t.telescregistry) AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM telescopes) > 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM observatories);
SELECT AVG(cnt) * 1.0 / SUM(cnt) AS average_share
FROM (
  SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM telescopes
  GROUP BY observstation
) t;
SELECT observstation, ABS(atmostransparency - (SELECT AVG(atmostransparency) FROM observatories)) AS abs_diff
FROM observatories
ORDER BY abs_diff DESC
LIMIT 10;
